body_text:
A function has a left inverse if and only if it is injective,
provided a value can be selected outside its image when needed. A
function has a right inverse if and only if it is surjective; the
assertion that every surjection has a right inverse is equivalent
to the axiom of choice. A two-sided inverse exists exactly for
bijections and is then unique.
